title: Search: 3D vertical charge-coupled device memory with stacked gate electrodes (closest hits US 9,935,121; US 6,420,215; US 12,439,597)
supports: Search for vertical CCD shift-register memory in a stacked-gate (3D NAND-like) stack returned only NAND-style vertical-channel and stacked flash patents; no CCD-specific prior art found (via search snippet). Used for N on I-01064, I-00601, I-08879, I-02002, I-05209.
